name: New Light Industries Limited
about: New Light Industries Limited manufactures and sells garments, tailored apparel and uniforms in India and internationally. The company offers school uniforms, including shirt, trousers, skirt, shorts, tie, belt, socks, sweater, blazer, waistcoat, T-shirt, hoodie set, and tracksuit. The company also offers corporate uniforms, including shirts, paint, blazers, T-shirts, and sweaters; and sportswear comprising T-shirt, shorts, and socks. The company was formerly known as New Light Apparels Limited and changed its name to New Light Industries Limited in August 2025. New Light Industries Limited was founded in 1959 and is based in New Delhi, India.
